description: S01 editorial rubric with an intimacy-craft overlay distilled from Diana Gabaldon's I Give You My Body.

criteria: An immediate scene question
Escalating pressure with causal beat transitions
An emotional transaction that changes across the scene
A meaningful epistemic and romantic turn
An earned aftermath and forward hook

anchors.0: No intelligible scene question, emotional transaction, or causal progression.
anchors.25: A premise is visible, but pressure is flat and intimate beats are decorative.
anchors.50: The scene progresses coherently, though emotional movement, escalation, or aftermath is uneven.
anchors.75: Each major beat changes pressure or relationship state and builds toward a consequential turn.
anchors.100: Plot, emotional exchange, and romantic recognition become one causal engine; the turn is surprising, inevitable, and launches the next scene.

criteria: Mara combines sheltered competence with live uncertainty
Livia has genuine skill and acquisitive care
Jonah's restraint carries a social cost
Attraction filters are specific to each character
Institutional incentives appear through behavior

anchors.0: Characters are interchangeable functions or contradict their governing traits.
anchors.25: Declared traits and generic attraction appear, but choices could belong to anyone.
anchors.50: At least two characters make plausible choices; relational specificity and contradiction remain thin.
anchors.75: All three reveal distinctive wants, bodies, attention, and limits through consequential behavior.
anchors.100: Character-specific desire, contradiction, relationship history, and institutional pressure generate every important turn.

criteria: The scene conducts a specific emotional exchange rather than substituting lust
Attraction changes attention
At least three selective sensory channels form a coherent motif
Dialogue and body language negotiate reciprocal awareness
Contact changes knowledge, trust, desire, or choice
Restraint increases tension, perception, freedom, or future possibility
No mechanical body inventory

anchors.0: No charge, or erotic pressure erases agency and emotional specificity.
anchors.25: Attraction is asserted through stock reactions, generic desirability, or mechanics.
anchors.50: There is specific charge and some reciprocity, but sensory detail, restraint, or contact remains detachable from the story.
anchors.75: Emotion, selective sensation, dialogue, atmosphere, and chosen limits intensify one another and alter the relationship.
anchors.100: The non-consummated encounter is the scene's emotional and causal engine: desire becomes precise knowledge, restraint becomes action, and removal of the charge would break the story.

criteria: Teaching occurs through discovery and consequence
Mara's embodied control changes what can be known
The wrist exercise remains physically intelligible
No detachable sermon
A reader can infer and transfer the practice

anchors.0: The lesson is absent, false, physically incoherent, or delivered only as exposition.
anchors.25: Characters explain the intended lesson without dramatizing a usable control.
anchors.50: The control appears and can be understood, but mechanics, emotion, or consequence are under-integrated.
anchors.75: Embodied action, result, and changed interpretation teach the practice with little detachable explanation.
anchors.100: The reader discovers the epistemic move through Mara's body and choices, feels its emotional cost, and can transfer it beyond the scene.

criteria: Sensory precision without checklist coverage
Controlled narrative distance
Sentence and paragraph rhythm
Dialogue/body-language counterpoint and subtext
Atmosphere that exerts dramatic pressure
Humor and fresh imagery
Absence of clinical choreography, ornate euphemism, and generic model cadences

anchors.0: Incoherent, mechanical, disembodied, or unusably generic prose.
anchors.25: Readable but dominated by summary, cliche, body inventory, talking heads, or decorative atmosphere.
anchors.50: Competent prose with intermittent embodiment, subtext, and distance control.
anchors.75: Rhythm, selective sensation, atmosphere, dialogue, and physical detail work together without calling attention to technique.
anchors.100: Line and scene scale are equally controlled; every close detail matters, every omission invites imagination, and the voice remains wholly in service of character and action.

criteria: Desire is integrated rather than suppressed
Dignity and freedom are causal
Restraint increases perception, delight, and future possibility
Embodied pleasure and judgment reinforce rather than cancel each other
Grace does not erase responsibility

anchors.0: The scene equates holiness with numbness, coercion, or consequence-free purity.
anchors.25: Virtue is stated as a rule while desire and embodiment remain dramatically inert.
anchors.50: Desire and limits coexist, but restraint mostly stops action rather than transforming it.
anchors.75: Freedom, attention, delight, restraint, and responsibility visibly reinforce one another.
anchors.100: The scene's spiritual anthropology is inseparable from its hottest choices: chastity enlarges perception and agency while intensifying rather than evading desire.

criteria: Observation does not automatically justify interpretation
Multiple explanations remain live
The cue-channel control matters
Embodied attraction sharpens rather than overrules inquiry
A smaller uncanny remainder survives

anchors.0: One total explanation is announced and desire functions as epistemic surrender.
anchors.25: The text gestures at ambiguity but covertly settles every cue in the preferred direction.
anchors.50: Mechanism, uncertainty, and attraction coexist, though one remains decorative.
anchors.75: The control changes justified belief while attraction and uncanny surplus preserve consequential uncertainty.
anchors.100: Embodied desire, ordinary mechanism, and uncanny surplus constrain one another, producing sharper inquiry, freer choice, and stronger romantic pressure.

romance_diagnostics.attraction_and_impediment: The first encounter introduces attraction and impediment together.
romance_diagnostics.relationship_delta: Romantic progress changes knowledge, trust, desire, leverage, or future possibility.
romance_diagnostics.competence_and_restraint: Competence attraction and morally attractive restraint arise from action.
romance_diagnostics.romance_turn: The scene contains recognition, interruption or impediment, chosen response, and a forward-driving romantic question.
romance_diagnostics.trope_execution: Tropes gain specificity or productive variation rather than merely appearing.
romance_diagnostics.character_before_mechanics: Intimacy reveals character before describing mechanics.
romance_diagnostics.selective_senses: At least three well-chosen sensory channels carry the encounter without checklist prose.
romance_diagnostics.dialogue_and_atmosphere: Dialogue, body language, and atmosphere jointly conduct the encounter.
romance_diagnostics.contact_changes_story: Physical contact changes knowledge, choice, trust, or relationship.
romance_diagnostics.productive_restraint: The unperformed act increases tension, perception, freedom, or future possibility.

intimacy_diagnostics.emotional_transaction: Name each participant's opening emotional offer, counteraction, and changed end state.
intimacy_diagnostics.character_specific_desire: Identify evidence that this attraction belongs specifically to Mara, Livia, or Jonah.
intimacy_diagnostics.dialogue_body_counterpoint: Identify where speech and physical behavior complicate rather than duplicate each other.
intimacy_diagnostics.sensory_triage: Identify the coherent sensory triad and whether any detail is merely checklist coverage.
intimacy_diagnostics.atmospheric_participation: Identify how the compound, witnesses, room, weather, sound, clothing, or objects alter behavior.
intimacy_diagnostics.consequential_contact: State precisely what the wrist contact changes.
intimacy_diagnostics.productive_restraint: State what Jonah's restraint costs and what possibility it creates.
intimacy_diagnostics.distance_control: Identify one justified close-up and one useful omission or widening.
intimacy_diagnostics.physical_intelligibility: Confirm that contact and experimental control can be spatially understood.
intimacy_diagnostics.relationship_delta: State the Mara/Jonah relationship before and after the scene in one sentence.

pairwise_priorities: Prefer the scene with the clearer and more consequential emotional transaction.
Prefer character-specific desire over generic heat.
Prefer selective sensation and active atmosphere over sensory quantity.
Prefer restraint that increases pressure over restraint that ends it.
Prefer contact that changes relationship or knowledge over prettier description.
When craft quality conflicts with locked canon or agency, locked canon and agency win.

defect_taxonomy.generic_competence: Model competence replaces the character's situated limitations.
defect_taxonomy.sermon_insertion: Instruction becomes detachable exposition rather than dramatic discovery.
defect_taxonomy.catchphrase_characterization: Repeated verbal tics substitute for decisions and relationships.
defect_taxonomy.relational_flatness: A character behaves the same way with every interlocutor.
defect_taxonomy.emotional_smoothing: The prose grants premature regulation or self-knowledge.
defect_taxonomy.pov_drift: Sustained access to a non-POV character's private state.
defect_taxonomy.fake_ambiguity: Uncertainty is asserted while the narration covertly settles the answer.
defect_taxonomy.source_parroting: Distinctive source language is reproduced rather than transformed.
defect_taxonomy.repetitive_body_shorthand: Stock bodily reactions substitute for selective sensation.
defect_taxonomy.anticlimactic_restraint: A limit drains energy instead of focusing perception and choice.
defect_taxonomy.heat_without_consequence: Erotic charge does not alter knowledge, freedom, or action.
defect_taxonomy.worldview_flattening: Contradictory commitments collapse into a tidy doctrine.
defect_taxonomy.temporal_collapse: Later knowledge or commitments leak into an earlier scene.
defect_taxonomy.mindreading_inflation: Inference about motive is narrated as direct fact.
defect_taxonomy.scene_capture: One retrieved anecdote or trope overwhelms the current scene.
defect_taxonomy.milieu_imitation: Subcultural voice substitutes for individual character.
defect_taxonomy.lust_as_emotion: Arousal vocabulary substitutes for an exchange of specific emotions.
defect_taxonomy.mechanics_without_emotion: Physical actions reveal no character, relationship, or emotional movement.
defect_taxonomy.clinical_inventory: The prose catalogs body parts, positions, or sequential operations.
defect_taxonomy.ornate_euphemism: Decorative anatomical language draws attention away from character and sensation.
defect_taxonomy.disembodied_dialogue: Conversation carries the scene while bodies and setting exert no pressure.
defect_taxonomy.silent_choreography: Body mechanics dominate while characters cease negotiating through language or expression.
defect_taxonomy.sensory_checklist: Sensory channels appear as coverage rather than coherent selection.
defect_taxonomy.atmospheric_vacuum: The encounter could occur in any room because setting does no dramatic work.
defect_taxonomy.static_contact: Touch occurs but changes no knowledge, choice, trust, or relationship state.
defect_taxonomy.generic_attraction: The point-of-view character notices stock desirability rather than character-specific signals.
defect_taxonomy.restraint_without_tension: A boundary or interruption merely deflates the scene.
defect_taxonomy.distance_monotony: The narration fails to control closeness and omission.
defect_taxonomy.unearned_lyricism: Metaphor announces significance unsupported by action and relationship.
defect_taxonomy.repeated_intimacy_template: The scene repeats a familiar escalation architecture without a new emotional purpose.
defect_taxonomy.logistics_failure: Bodies, clothing, timing, or space become impossible or confusing.
defect_taxonomy.emotion_without_consequence: Feelings are named or vividly rendered but do not change action or relationship.
